actual: The UI did not make full experiment/task/loop visibility explicit and /quantevolver/evolution/tasks only exposed a limit-based list, making older tasks invisible to the page once the first page was exhausted.
closure_requirements: GitHub Issue #61 remains linked to this BUG record.
The experiment history page can load all parent experiments and child loops in batches and exposes count/full-view evidence.
The evolution tasks API accepts offset and the UI loads all task pages in batches.
Summary task payloads expose a compact hmm_enabled flag instead of returning raw strategy JSON for list visibility.
No experiment data is deleted and no production DB write or DDL is performed.
description: The QE experiment history and evolution task pages can make saved experiments, tasks, and loops hard to discover because history is paged/folded without a full-visibility signal and the evolution task list did not support paged full loading. Users cannot safely inspect HMM/QE history before cleanup decisions.

events.note: Original GitHub mirror recorded this issue as #61; local BUG numbering later normalized to BUG-059 to avoid duplicate BUG-058 reuse.
Continuing from isolated worktree and excluding simulation/Paper v2/MiniQMT/StrategyPackage manifest drift per user instruction.
Implemented full visibility loading for QE experiment history and evolution tasks; validation passed except full project tsc is blocked by unrelated research-assistant syntax error on current main.
Committed fix branch after rebase on origin/main; final commit hash will be recorded by close-sync after PR/merge to avoid self-referential BUG JSON drift.

expected: The existing QE UI style is preserved while users can load all saved parent experiments, child loops, and evolution tasks, see full-view/count indicators, expand/collapse all loops, and verify HMM-related task visibility without deleting data.
non_goals: Do not delete QE/HMM experiments or filesystem data.
Do not process Paper v2, MiniQMT, or StrategyPackage manifest drift in this issue.
Do not redesign the UI or migrate it to a new visual system.
reproduce_command: Open /quantevolver/experiments and /quantevolver/evolution, then compare visible parent/loop/task counts with GET /api/v1/quantevolver/experiments?include_children=true and GET /api/v1/quantevolver/evolution/tasks?limit=200&offset=0.
title: QE experiment history and evolution pages do not show all saved experiments
